name: dopamyn
description: X (Twitter) intelligence and DM outreach for crypto brands, from your Dopamyn workspace. Requires an active Dopamyn subscription.

interface.longDescription: Dopamyn connects your Dopamyn workspace to ChatGPT. Search X accounts, analyze followers, save accounts as lists, launch, pause and resume DM campaigns to a list, see reply rates, triage replies, and send a DM from your connected X account. Nothing is sent until you approve the message and the recipients. Every DM uses the same monthly allowance and message credits as a send from the Dopamyn app. Requires an active Dopamyn subscription.
defaultPrompt: Use Dopamyn to show replies to my DM campaigns that still need an answer.
Use Dopamyn to find DeFi founders on X with more than 10k followers and save them as a list.
Use Dopamyn to compare reply rates across my DM campaigns this month.
